title: TRUMP
description:
Sophie, a boy with vampire and human blood, is transferred from an orphanage to an institution called Clan. The school houses vampire boys who have reached their Cocoon period, or puberty in human terms. Sophie has a fateful encounter with a boy named Ul while being coldly greeted by the vampires around him. As Ul continues to research the “power of immortality” that vampires once possessed, he learns of the existence of TRUMP, the original vampire that is said to live forever, and begins to crave eternal life.

Eventually, Sophie and Ul become entangled in the deep fate surrounding the legend of immortality...

A manga adaptation of the origin story of playwright Kenichi Suemitsu’s popular series! A Gothic school fantasy that beautifully spins the conflicts of impressionable and sensitive boysー!
author: Suemitsu Kenichi

title: The Hero's Bereaved Family
description:
The hero who defeated the Demon King and saved the world has died. Gil, a half-elf who carries his blood, heads eagerly to the funeral of the "father he's never met" after hearing about an inheritance, but...!? The womanizing hero's love-starved children collide in a ruthless, blood-soaked inheritance battle! Will it end in a mountain of corpses... or something else entirely!?
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [Young Jump+](https://ynjn.jp/title/28663)
author: Kanemaki Maki

title: Gray Part-Time Jobs: No Escape
description:
Ura baito, also known as a shady part-time job: a gray area job that pays very well. The price you pay is your life. Yume Kokuryo and Nagomi Shirahama are seeking a large sum of money for some reason. To that end, they casually dive into various shady part-time jobs.
___
This work may affect you physically and mentally. Read it at your own risk. We are not responsible for any damage to your health.
author: Taguchi Shoutarou

title: Wagamama Oujo ni Tsukaeta Bannou Shitsuji, Tonari no Teikoku de Saikyou no Gunjin ni Nariagari Musou Suru
description:
Leet isn’t just any butler. His mistress, Princess Kilik, demands the impossible—and he delivers it, seven times before breakfast. But one day, Leet decides enough is enough, and he flees for a neighboring land where the talented rise up through the ranks instead of languishing in thankless, dead-end jobs. Under a new name, Lilt, he enrolls in a training and job placement program, and rapidly discovers that, easy as “wax on, wax off,” his butlering skills make him a valuable asset!

*Source: Kodansha Comics, Vol. 1*

**Links:**
- [Alternative Official Raw on Nico Nico Seiga](https://seiga.nicovideo.jp/comic/54400)
author: Skyfarm (すかいふぁーむ)

title: Save the Earth!
description: A series of Kang Ha-ram's crazy school life— survive, Kang Ha-ram!
author: Maem (맴​)

title: Ghost Fixers
description: Following a certain event, Mikurigaoka New Town transformed into a crucible of supernatural phenomena known as GHOSTS! In said town lives Hifumi, a middle school boy, who one day encounters a girl who just moved in...
author: Tanaka Yasuki

title: Something small and cute
description: Follow the adventures of Chiikawa the innocent cute creature, Hachiware the kind cat, and Usagi the chaotic rabbit as they work their hardest to survive in a world filled with dangerous monsters, mysterious armored taskmasters, and fantastical phenomena at every turn!
author: Nagano

title: I Hate That We're Childhood Friends!: My Rise to the Top of School Life with an S-Rank Beauty Begins After a Falling-Out
description: Kazuma Suzuki was just your average high schooler—until his childhood friend, Rua Takayashiki, a beautiful, sharp-tongued girl who also happened to be the granddaughter of the school chairman and the nation's top idol, cut all ties with him using a line straight out of a drama. Forced into submission for years as her so-called childhood friend, Kazuma decides it's finally time for his first-ever rebellion. He's done playing lapdog. This time, he's taking back his freedom—and aiming for a normal school life. Escaping a powerful beauty like her is easier said than done...
author: Yuuji Yuuji

title: The Little Lady Behind the Scenes
description:
Julianne is as close to perfect as it gets: she’s got looks, talent, and smarts. The only problem is she has terrible taste in men! That’s why her little sister Lilianne is doing everything she can to make sure she doesn’t end up with the wrong guy. However, Julianne’s suitors are quickly catching on that the way to her heart is through Lilianne’s sweet tooth! How far will Lilianne go to set her sister up with the right man? Who will be the sweetest suitor?

---
I was the only younger sister of the female protagonist in the reverse harem novel. In addition, I was exceptionally pampered by the female lead after waking up after being very sick. I used that to defeat the original inexcusable trash male leads who only hurt my sister…

‘Lili, how are you? Do you like cake?’

‘Lili is really pretty because she resembles her sister. Won’t you eat cookies? Please tell your sister that these were given to you by your wonderful brother.’

‘Would you like to eat this and go over there for a while? I have something to say to your uncle and sister.’

For some reason, the male lead candidates seem anxious to see me.

**

“I don’t play with ugly kids," the boy in front of me muttered with a deep frown.

What? Did you really just say that? I’ll show you what the real world is like.

I gently pulled the hem of my sister’s clothes and shook my head, “I hate him, so I hate the older brother who brought him.”

At the same time, Cedric’s face turned pale, similar to someone who had been sentenced to death.
author: Yehwon (예훤), Seonsaeng

title: Ushiyama-san
description:
Ushiyama-san, the popular girl in class. I thought she was someone I would never have anything to do with…
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [niconico Manga](https://manga.nicovideo.jp/comic/75817)
author: Aizawa Haruyoshi

title: Momoiro Meloik
description: Yamato loves his little sister. His sister is the cutest and sweetest girl in the world, and he won't settle for second best. Unfortunately, everyday life and the rest of the world intrude on his idyllic plans, and he finds it's not as simple as he imagines it should be. Follow along with tough Yamato and cute Masaki as they deal with the problems of an otherwise normal family life.
author: Fukuda Shinichi

title: The Villainess Becomes a Mom
description:
Reborn into a novel, Lulu Ekray knew that she was destined to become the villainess and that she would fall in love with the male protagonist, her obsession with him eventually leading to her execution. Nonetheless, she falls in love with Grand Duke Carlix Rochester anyway, but now, the obsessive one is him! 

After a night of passion, Lulu gets pregnant, but to avoid becoming the villainess, she decides to leave Carlix. But Lulu has no idea just what lengths Carlix will go to get her back!
author: Dodam (도담 from WHYNOTME), Sisse (시세)

title: Tokusatsu Gagaga
description: Nakamura Kano is an OL (office lady) with a secret… she’s a “Toku Otaku,” a tokusatsu otaku who is obsessed with live action dramas of heroes, monsters and robots. She thinks they’re “JUST TOO COOL!” She’s so obsessed that she skips out on drinking with colleagues to watch it on TV and collects the DVDs, books and figurines. She lives her life by the code of the tokusatsu heroes, and constantly imagines them to help her through difficult situations. But this isn’t easy when all of her co-workers think that people who like anime and other childish things are weird, and they keep trying to make her socialize.
author: Tanba Niwa

title: Beast Tamer
description: Because Rein was a weak and simple beast tamer, he was expelled from the hero's group but that didn't stop his desire to be an adventurer. By taking simple quests afterwards he has a destined encounter with a strong cat girl.
author: Miyama Suzu

title: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure, Part 9: The JoJoLands - Digital Colored Comics
description:
The ninth story arc of JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure.

O’ahu, early 2020s. Dua Lipa is a trending musician, and COVID is still a major concern. On this island lives a 15-year-old boy named Jodio Joestar. Alongside his sibling, Dragona Joestar, they act as dealers for certain illegal substances. One day, their employer comes and shows them an excellent find: a Japanese person has landed in Hawaii with a diamond worth over six million dollars. Normally it would be impossible to steal, but for two siblings with Stands…

This is a story of a young boy and his quest to become rich.
author: Araki Hirohiko

title: Forced to Be an Invincible Saintess
description: The true identity of the saint that is worshipped by all the people in the kingdom is actually an average boy? With the beautiful priest, the big breasted knight, and the loli doctor at the side, the road of a saintess is really difficult...
author: Xingkong She

title: I, an Ordinary Guy with No Redeeming Qualities, Risked My Life to Save Beautiful Twin Sisters, Only to Make the Secretly Yandere Duo Fall Madly in Love with Me
description:
Yagami Ryoya, an ordinary high school boy with no particular redeeming qualities, saved the lives of the school's idol twin sisters from a violent thug. That was the beginning of their sweet yet abnormal "repayment"─.
Reona and Riona close the distance, affirming his every move and spoiling him to the absolute limit. However, their love is a "yandere" obsession that goes way beyond just being "super heavy"...!?
Dragging in his family, his environment, and everything else around him, the twin sisters completely seal off Ryoya's escape routes. They are undeniably cute, but there is nowhere to run. What will become of Ryoya's fate now that he is locked onto by a 100% pure desire for monopoly!?
Packed with lovey-dovey moments! An unpredictable romantic comedy where the protagonist gets completely tossed around, officially begins!
author: Mizushima Satori

title: Today's Urabe-san with…
description:
Urabe Haruna, 24 years old. Hobbies: smoking, drinking, cosplay.

Urabe Haruna, a girl whose daily posts on social media are accompanied by 1 word, “Today”, has been turned into a serialized comic! She spends her days messing with, teasing, and toying with her junior, Kinoshita-kun.
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [niconico Manga](https://sp.manga.nicovideo.jp/comic/70408)
author: mashimashi

title: With Regard to My Dear Kudan
description:
Kudan: a half-human, half-bovine yokai endowed with the power of prophecy.

One novel catches the eye of fiction editor Hazama Yuu. He soon discovers that it was written by Saka Madarako, a kudan girl who used her prophetic power to turn their shared future into fiction.
author: Hashi
